mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_message (conversation_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, message_type, extra_info, send_time, is_read, is_deleted) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{extraInfo}, #{sendTime}, #{isRead}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.sender_type AS senderType, m.content, m.message_type AS messageType, m.extra_info AS extraInfo, m.send_time AS sendTime, m.is_read AS isRead, CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 0 THEN u.name WHEN m.sender_type = 1 THEN a.name ELSE '系统' END AS senderName, CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 0 THEN u.avatar WHEN m.sender_type = 1 THEN a.avatar ELSE NULL END AS senderAvatar FROM conversation_message m LEFT JOIN user_info u ON m.sender_type = 0 AND m.sender_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON m.sender_type = 1 AND m.sender_id = a.id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.send_time ASC

SELECT id, conversation_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, message_type, extra_info, send_time, is_read, is_deleted FROM conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY send_time ASC
